title: AI Taking Over Junior Dev Jobs?
full_monologue: **AI agents are replacing junior developers**. It’s happening faster than you think. These AI tools can write clean code, debug issues, and even understand project requirements—without needing a coffee break. Some companies are already using them to automate repetitive tasks, and the result? Faster development cycles and fewer entry-level roles. But here’s the catch: AI isn’t replacing creativity or problem-solving. It’s just a tool. So, what does this mean for your career? Let me know in the comments.
